headline: Up Your Arsenal's PAL v1.00 matched code rises from 32.22% to 36.93%
summary: Up Your Arsenal's progress report puts PAL v1.00 at 36.93% matched code, up from 32.22%, with 10,105 of 16,124 functions. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. This was a busy day for a branch usually seeing occasional updates, with work across levels, menus and startup code.
highlights: #63 brings 17 matched PAL functions to Obani Moons, including vector-unit work. Seven functions remain in assembly.
PAL work from #58, #59 and #61 landed as commits, covering Aridia, Thran Asteroid Belt, level 23 and shared level 6 code.
Two PAL routines from #62 landed for Daxx and shared vector code. Its submission said NTSC-U carry was required before merge and no NTSC-U disc was available locally.
NTSC-U's latest progress commit lists 10,204 of 16,169 functions, with more matches landing afterward. Another 231 NTSC-U drafts remain outside the matched build.
Level work also covers Aquatos, the special-edition first vidcomic and the multiplayer menu.
#64 proposes readable function names and comments on NTSC-U functions. It remains open and adds no matches.
